summary.ja: 純吸収平板の離散座標輻射輸送: 純吸収の定常輻射輸送を角度と空間で離散化し、Beer–Lambert解と積分された出射フラックスで検証します。 輻射輸送：空間・角度収束と光子統計: 純吸収平板で特性解・独立適応求積・光子生存率を比較し、離散収支と標本誤差・区間被覆を別々に測ります。 追加固定例：等方散乱平板の反射・透過・吸収。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：Su–Olson1996非平衡拡散、Su–Olson1997角度輸送の独立公開表比較。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：2D吸収影と保存的M1輸送、2D反向beamとM1閉包の情報損失。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab: Discretize steady pure-absorption transfer in angle and space, checking Beer–Lambert rays and integrated exit flux. Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics: Compare characteristics, independent adaptive integration and photon survival in a pure-absorption slab; separate discrete balance, sampling error and interval coverage. Additional fixed examples: Isotropic scattering in a finite slab. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Su–Olson1996 non-equilibrium diffusion, Su–Olson transport with an independently published analytical table. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Two-dimensional absorber shadow and M1 transport, Opposing beams and information loss in the M1 closure. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

limitations.ja: 純吸収平板の離散座標輻射輸送: 多重散乱、熱輻射、周波数再分配、動的媒質、輻射流体連成は未実装です。StamnesらのDISORTの全機能・安定化を再現したとは表示しません。 輻射輸送：空間・角度収束と光子統計: 区間被覆は有限の固定seedでの観測で、ちょうど95%の実測値や全seedの成功を保証しません。決定論的求積誤差を統計誤差へ含めず、多重散乱・周波数依存・熱輻射・輻射流体連成は未検証です。 今回の追加固定例：有限の4平板に限定。MC、一般角度phase関数、DISORT再現、普遍的次数や厳密連続体誤差境界は認証しません。 今回の追加固定例：1996拡散であり1997角度輸送とは別です。原典本文は未読、公式ソフトの選択値を資格。物理単位の質量opacity解釈は使わず無次元関数を直接参照します。 原1997本文・原表と直接照合したとはしません。公開表の転記か再生成かは著者READMEに未記載。source停止後、一般散乱、全時空間の連続体誤差や角度次数は未認証です。 この追加はκhを解像したN∝κ²の半離散周期制御で、固定格子AP性や主SSPRK2の拡散時間次数を認証しません。初期F0と非零Fick流束の初期層を保持し、極限判定は最終s=.25のみ。両行列伝播にSciPy sparse expm_multiplyを共有し、DOP853照合は参照伝播器の資格です。 今回の追加固定例：6軸は整列beam用で一般角度収束ではありません。反向beamのM1差はモデル情報損失として示し、角度輸送への収束を要求しません。相対論・気体流体・多周波RHDではありません。 6軸は整列beam用で一般角度収束ではありません。反向beamのM1差はモデル情報損失として示し、角度輸送への収束を要求しません。相対論・気体流体・多周波RHDではありません。
limitations.en: Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab: Multiple scattering, thermal emission, frequency redistribution, moving media and radiation–fluid coupling are unimplemented. This does not reproduce full DISORT functionality/stabilization. Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics: Coverage is observed over finite fixed seeds; neither exactly 95% empirical coverage nor all-seed success is guaranteed. Keep deterministic quadrature error separate from statistical error. Multiple scattering, frequency dependence, thermal emission and radiation hydrodynamics are unvalidated. Additional fixed examples: Limited to fourfixedisotropic slabs;noMC,generalphase-function/DISORT reproduction,universalorder or rigorouscontinuumerrorbound. Additional fixed examples: This1996diffusion model is distinct from1997angular transport. Original paper fulltext unread;officialsoftware selected values qualified. Direct dimensionless functions avoid ambiguous mass-opacity physical-wrapper units. No direct original1997fulltext/tablecomparison claim. TheauthorREADMEdoesnotstate transcriptionversusregeneration. Source-offprofiles,generalscattering,globalcontinuumerrorandangularorderarenotcertified. The addition is a resolved N~kappa^2 semidiscrete periodic control,not fixed-grid AP or an SSPRK2 diffusion-time order certificate. Initial F0 versus nonzero Fick flux is retained;limit gates use final s=.25 only. SciPy sparse expm_multiply is shared;DOP853 qualifies the reference propagator. Additional fixed examples: Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. The M1 opposing-beam mismatch is expected information loss and is not required to converge to angular transport. No relativistic, gas-dynamical or multifrequency radiation hydrodynamics is implemented. Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. title.ja: 純吸収平板の離散座標輻射輸送
title.en: Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab

summary.ja: 純吸収の定常輻射輸送を角度と空間で離散化し、Beer–Lambert解と積分された出射フラックスで検証します。
summary.en: Discretize steady pure-absorption transfer in angle and space, checking Beer–Lambert rays and integrated exit flux.

assumptions.ja: 光学的厚さ0.7の一様平板。正の半球から単位強度が入射し、逆向きの入射・散乱・内部輻射はゼロです。
assumptions.en: A uniform slab of optical depth 0.7 receives unit intensity over the positive hemisphere, with zero reverse inflow, scattering and emission.

algorithm.ja: 正のGauss–Legendre離散方向と1次風上有限体積の空間行進を使います。角度誤差だけを分ける系列では、一定セル内を指数関数で正確に伝播します。
algorithm.en: Use positive Gauss–Legendre ordinates and first-order upstream finite-volume marching. A separate angular-error sweep uses exact exponential propagation within each constant cell.

validation.ja: 32〜512セルで全方向の強度誤差・空間フラックス誤差・正値性・離散吸収収支を確認。4〜32方向の別系列は、出射フラックス2pi E3(tau)の解析表示と比較します。
validation.en: With 32–512 cells, check all ray intensities, spatial flux error, positivity and discrete absorption balance. A separate 4–32-ordinate sweep compares exit flux with the analytic 2pi E3(tau) representation.

limits.ja: 多重散乱、熱輻射、周波数再分配、動的媒質、輻射流体連成は未実装です。StamnesらのDISORTの全機能・安定化を再現したとは表示しません。
limits.en: Multiple scattering, thermal emission, frequency redistribution, moving media and radiation–fluid coupling are unimplemented. This does not reproduce full DISORT functionality/stabilization.

title.ja: 輻射輸送：空間・角度収束と光子統計
title.en: Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics

summary.ja: 純吸収平板で特性解・独立適応求積・光子生存率を比較し、離散収支と標本誤差・区間被覆を別々に測ります。
summary.en: Compare characteristics, independent adaptive integration and photon survival in a pure-absorption slab; separate discrete balance, sampling error and interval coverage.

assumptions.ja: 定常一様平板、光学的厚さ.1/.7/3、正の半球から単位強度、逆入射・散乱・内部輻射0。フラックス基準の光子入射方向はpdf=2muです。
assumptions.en: Steady uniform slab, optical depths .1/.7/3, unit incoming positive-hemisphere intensity, no reverse inflow/scattering/emission. Incoming photon directions for a flux estimator have density 2mu.

algorithm.ja: 1次風上有限体積の空間更新とGauss–Legendre方向を使い、角度系列は正確な指数伝播で空間誤差を除きます。MCはmu=sqrt(U)と指数光学距離から生存・吸収を独立に判定します。
algorithm.en: Use upstream finite volumes and Gauss-Legendre ordinates; exact exponential propagation removes spatial error in the angle series. Monte Carlo independently tracks survival/absorption using mu=sqrt(U) and exponential optical paths.

validation.ja: 16〜256セル・4〜64方向を別に収束させ、QUADPACK積分とE3を照合。64seed・1024/4096/16384光子で平均誤差、RMSE、二項標準偏差と95% Clopper–Pearson区間の実測被覆を記録します。全光子の出射＋吸収、正値性と離散フラックス収支を確認します。
validation.en: Refine 16–256 cells and 4–64 ordinates separately; compare QUADPACK integration with E3. For 64 seeds and 1024/4096/16384 photons, record mean error, RMSE, binomial standard deviation and observed 95% Clopper–Pearson coverage. Check photon exit-plus-absorption counts, positivity and discrete flux balance.

limits.ja: 区間被覆は有限の固定seedでの観測で、ちょうど95%の実測値や全seedの成功を保証しません。決定論的求積誤差を統計誤差へ含めず、多重散乱・周波数依存・熱輻射・輻射流体連成は未検証です。
limits.en: Coverage is observed over finite fixed seeds; neither exactly 95% empirical coverage nor all-seed success is guaranteed. Keep deterministic quadrature error separate from statistical error. Multiple scattering, frequency dependence, thermal emission and radiation hydrodynamics are unvalidated.

summary.ja: 正負の角度を結合した実際の定常輸送を解き、独立な連続角Fredholm参照とR/T/Aを比較します。
summary.en: Solve genuinely coupled signed-angle steady transport and compare R/T/A with an independent continuum-angle Fredholm reference.

assumptions.ja: 光学厚さ.5/3、単一散乱albedo.5/.9の4入力。左の等方入射I1、右入射0。64/128/256セル、32角と独立64角probe。
assumptions.en: Four fixed inputs L=.5/3,albedo=.5/.9;unit left incoming radiance,right vacuum incoming.64/128/256cells at32signed angles and a separate64angle probe.

algorithm.ja: 保存的風上FVの全方向source結合を離散sweep応答で解きます。半球ごとの正重みGaussにより入射流束πを正規化し、吸収は体積sourceから独立積算します。
algorithm.en: Conservative upwind FV with the full discrete angular source coupling solved by sweep-response elimination. Positive hemisphere Gauss weights normalize incoming fluxpi;absorption is independently accumulated from the volume source.

validation.ja: 独立参照78項目はmain前に合格。主18計算では収支・正値・残差と、別々の空間・角度差、純吸収・保存散乱controlを判定します。
validation.en: Independent reference78checks passed before main.18primary/control solves test budget,positivity,residuals,separate space/angle changes,pure absorption and conservative scattering.

limits.ja: 有限の4平板に限定。MC、一般角度phase関数、DISORT再現、普遍的次数や厳密連続体誤差境界は認証しません。
limits.en: Limited to fourfixedisotropic slabs;noMC,generalphase-function/DISORT reproduction,universalorder or rigorouscontinuumerrorbound.

assumptions.ja: 2D空間と3D角度測度、c1、静止吸収体。実S_Nと非線形M1を24/48/96格子で進め、同一solverの変動方向MMS・x/y交差packet controlを保持。
assumptions.en: Two spatial dimensions, a three-dimensional angular measure, c=1 and static absorption. Evolve the actual signed-angle and nonlinear M1 equations on24/48/96grids. Same-solver controls retain a varying-direction manufactured solution and crossed x/y packets.

algorithm.ja: 風上角度FV／M1のRusanovとSSPRK2。吸収は保存ledger付き指数分割。6軸重み1/6、単位beamのnodal強度6、Pzzと全3Dtraceを保持。floor/projectionはしません。 旧c1 Rusanovの横拡散による3不合格を保持し、一般状態の方向別Jacobian固有値・LF円錐分割・法線flux比の最大を一面係数に採用。全ghost面と台帳へ同じfluxを使い、真空と既存許容丸め域の速度だけ1へ拡張して回数・最大超過を記録します。U/Pの投影や純beam特例branchはありません。
algorithm.en: Conservative upwind angular finite volumes or M1 Rusanov fluxes with SSPRK2; exponential absorption with a separate deposited-energy ledger. Six axis directions have weight1/6; a unit beam has nodal intensity6. Retain Pzz and the full3D trace. No positive floor or cone projection. The revised general directional local-LF coefficient is the maximum of endpoint spectral radii,an independently derived cone-splitting bound,and normal reduced flux. Use the same face rule on all ghost boundaries and in the ledger. Explicit speed-only vacuum/allowed-roundoff extension1 is counted; no U/P projection or special beam branch. Preserve the original c1 transverse-diffusion failure.

validation.ja: 独立な特性cell平均と閉M1強制項の複素step検査191項目がmain前に合格。全step収支・cone・正値、別時間probe、MMSとx/y実進行の収束を検査します。 新fluxの762固定成分判定がPDE改訂前に合格。旧17pytestを維持し方向別fluxの5回帰を追加した22pytestと、元24計算・166科学判定を同じ120秒上限で再検査します。
validation.en: The independent characteristic cell averages and manufactured M1 forcing passed191reference/component checks before any PDE main. Check all-step budgets, realizability and positivity, spatial refinement, a separate half-step probe, and actual x/y evolution. Opposing-beam closure error is distinguished from numerical error. The new general flux passed762fixed component checks before this revised PDE main. Retain the17old tests and add5directional regressions=22tests; all24fixed runs and166scientific gates remain unchanged under the same120second limit.

limits.ja: 6軸は整列beam用で一般角度収束ではありません。反向beamのM1差はモデル情報損失として示し、角度輸送への収束を要求しません。相対論・気体流体・多周波RHDではありません。
limits.en: Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. The M1 opposing-beam mismatch is expected information loss and is not required to converge to angular transport. No relativistic, gas-dynamical or multifrequency radiation hydrodynamics is implemented.

note.ja: 原1997本文・原表と直接照合したとはしません。公開表の転記か再生成かは著者READMEに未記載。source停止後、一般散乱、全時空間の連続体誤差や角度次数は未認証です。 この追加はκhを解像したN∝κ²の半離散周期制御で、固定格子AP性や主SSPRK2の拡散時間次数を認証しません。初期F0と非零Fick流束の初期層を保持し、極限判定は最終s=.25のみ。両行列伝播にSciPy sparse expm_multiplyを共有し、DOP853照合は参照伝播器の資格です。
note.en: No direct original1997fulltext/tablecomparison claim. TheauthorREADMEdoesnotstate transcriptionversusregeneration. Source-offprofiles,generalscattering,globalcontinuumerrorandangularorderarenotcertified. The addition is a resolved N~kappa^2 semidiscrete periodic control,not fixed-grid AP or an SSPRK2 diffusion-time order certificate. Initial F0 versus nonzero Fick flux is retained;limit gates use final s=.25 only. SciPy sparse expm_multiply is shared;DOP853 qualifies the reference propagator.

problem_name.en: Two-dimensional absorber shadow and M1 transport

title.ja: 円形吸収体の特性線参照

note.ja: 6軸は整列beam用で一般角度収束ではありません。反向beamのM1差はモデル情報損失として示し、角度輸送への収束を要求しません。相対論・気体流体・多周波RHDではありません。
note.en: Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. The M1 opposing-beam mismatch is expected information loss and is not required to converge to angular transport. No relativistic, gas-dynamical or multifrequency radiation hydrodynamics is implemented.
